title: A price exactly at cost does not warn, a deeper discount does
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with one range from $0.00: Default on Markup % 0, tier A on % Off 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Default's 0% markup value shows no warning icon.
  • Tier A's 1% off value shows the warning icon to its right.
